title: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving
grouping: A 2x2 arrangement of real data without frames, each quadrant with a bold heading: camera images (top left), predicted 3-D occupancy (top right), sparse LiDAR points (bottom left), generated dense occupancy (bottom right). Verb-labelled black arrows join them ('predict' left-to-right on top, 'generate' left-to-right below, 'supervise' bottom-to-top on the right). A one-line class legend of coloured squares runs along the bottom.
shapes_depth: The camera input is six photos placed in a ring around a top-view yellow car icon. Occupancy is shown as oblique 3-D voxel renders in semantic colours (magenta drivable surface, greens for vegetation and terrain, blue cars, red pedestrians, light grey man-made); the LiDAR sweep is a sparse oblique point render coloured by class. No boxes or network glyphs at all.
proposed_highlight: The contribution (dense labels generated from sparse LiDAR) is the lower row, tied to the prediction by the upward 'supervise' arrow; both voxel scenes share the bottom legend's colours.
lesson: Lay the task out as a 2x2 of real data: camera ring around a top-view ego car and the predicted voxel scene on top, the sparse LiDAR sweep and the dense label it generates below, joined by verb-labelled arrows (predict, generate, supervise) under one semantic colour legend.
notes: Venue ICCV 2023 from the arXiv comment (venue_source: arxiv-journal-ref). The caption calls this figure an overview, but it shows the task setup and supervision source with no network, so it is carded as a teaser. flow 'mixed': left-to-right on both rows, bottom-to-top on the right. The whole figure is a single raster image in the PDF (refs crop recorded one embedded image covering the crop), so kb measure cannot separate photos from drawing: photo_share is null and the palette includes the embedded photos and renders.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
